news.paragraph: Silver prices are facing headwinds due to weakening demand, according to recent analysis. While SLV has seen significant gains over the past year, its performance is tempered by a notable fee structure and tax implications. Some reports suggest alternative silver ETFs may be outperforming SLV, and a prediction indicated potential upside after May 15th, though current demand trends suggest pressure.
